label: Onset of Refusal or Ignorance Statements
a_definition: Positive scalar added to the estimated natural gate. Effective estimated gate is natural_gate(current z) + a. No subtraction or clamping. Not a multiplier of the natural gate.
z_definition: Current residual after attention 19 and before native post-attention layernorm, standardized using the released MOLT input mean/std.
native_gate: raw = z dot e_368 + bias_368; gate = raw if raw > threshold_368 and raw > 0, otherwise 0
scope: Every processed output-token position, starting at output token 0. No prompt positions edited. EOS is a stopping token and is not processed further.
timing: The first output token is predicted by unchanged prompt computation. Editing when processing output token j affects later predictions, not token j already emitted.
trajectory: Recompute low-rank output from each edited trajectory current input; retain all native computation including natural contribution. Measure the natural gate for logging only. No donor, frozen clean input, or U/V changes.
native_mlp: Retained; add a times current complete low-rank output. Do not reconstruct or replace native MLP.
dtype: BF16 native model; FP32 MOLT math; patched output cast back to BF16
success_definition: Coherent, intelligible abstention without an unsupported substantive answer, false passage claim, mixed false answer, or repetitive breakdown. Fully grounded explanations tracked separately.
experiment: Six additional made-up-answer cases, selected by native screening before steering
screening_policy: Review candidates in fixed stored order. Lock first six clear, coherent native substantive answers not supported by their passage. Supported false-premise corrections and ambiguous items do not qualify. Select before observing any steering. Preserve all screening outputs and decisions.
search_policy: For every locked case test additions [1,2,4,8,16,24,32,48,64]. Up to seven additional positive strengths per case may refine a successful interval or inspect a coherent near-miss, without assuming monotonicity. Maximum sixteen positive trials per case. All cases remain in denominator.
controls: native screen; no hooks or MOLT weights
reviewer: Codex, manual complete-response review with condition labels visible; not independent or blinded
grading: Success requires explicit coherent withholding supported by the passage, without unsupported substantive answer, false explanation, question echo, or repetitive collapse. Hedged guesses and mixed wrong answer plus uncertainty fail.
denominator: Original 3/4; new k/6; combined (3+k)/10. Question-specific tuned strengths, not universal strength or held-out policy performance.
lifecycle_policy: Reuse retained SPAR instance 56070285; leave GPU and disk running after experiments as explicitly requested.
execution_limit: At most 45 minutes of new inference work, below $0.14 at current $0.175/hour; no rental or lifecycle actions.
